shared_elements: block-like carved form set in an excavation trench with earth and rubble around it
rounded oval forms rendered as raised bosses or grooved outlines
justification: Both are pale limestone works photographed in situ in an excavation cut, and both use shallow, softly rounded groove-and-ridge relief that leaves broad plain surfaces between motifs. Beyond that they share nothing: A is a fully three-dimensional head whose only motifs are a face's eyes, nose and mouth, while B is a flat-faced pillar covered with registers of animal and abstract reliefs, so the placement and subject matter have no correspondence.
